newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Splash Technology started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Splash Technology started.

text.p: -- Piper Jaffray said it initiated coverage of Splash Technology Holdings Inc with a strong buy rating and set a 12-month target price of $36 a share.
-- It said product introductions will solidify the company as the leader in open systems color servers.
-- Piper Jaffray said additional OEM partners could add to distribution and provide upside to earnings forecasts.
-- It said it expects Splash to earn $0.91 a share in 1997.
-- Splash gained 2-3/8 to 26-1/2 in early afternoon trading.
